gaps: All four years used the XLT trim filter; each filtered page showed 20-31 listings, so the unfiltered fallback was not needed.
TrueCar prices are the 'Advertised price' and the page states dealer fees/add-ons are included.

page_average values come from the page's FAQ sentence 'The average price for the <year> Ford Explorer XLT is $X'. The figure is identical on the 2016, 2019 and 2024 pages ($22,923) and barely different on 2022 ($23,010), and it does not track the visible listing prices, so it appears to be a model-wide XLT average rather than a year-specific one. Compute your own mean from the listings instead.

2022 and 2024 pages skew heavily toward 4WD listings in the Northeast/Midwest; the 2016 and 2019 pages mix FWD and 4WD. The 2020+ Explorer is rear-drive based, so 2WD rows show 'RWD' rather than 'FWD'.
All four years used the XLT trim filter; each filtered page showed 29-32 listings, so the unfiltered fallback was not needed.
TrueCar prices are the 'Advertised price' and the page states dealer fees/add-ons are included.

page_average values come from the page's FAQ sentence 'The average price for the <year> Ford F-150 XLT is $X'. The figure is nearly identical across all four years ($32,770 / $32,770 / $32,901 / $32,832) and does not track the visible listing prices, so it appears to be a model-wide XLT average rather than a year-specific one. Use with caution; compute your own mean from the listings instead.
Only the first 20 of 29-32 cards per page were recorded, per the brief's cap.
2023 Touring: TrueCar stated no average for this trim
2022: the SE-filtered page had only 14 listings nationwide (all recorded); still >= 8 so the unfiltered page was not fetched.
TrueCar's FAQ average ($16,088) is not year-specific; no year-specific 'averages $X' figure was found on the pages.

2016: the ?trim=sv filter returned no exact matches (TrueCar labels 2016 trims '2.5 SV'), so the unfiltered 2016 page was used; mixed trims (2.5 S / SV / SR / SL) recorded per row and page_average left null.

TrueCar's stated 'average price for the <year> Altima SV' is $19,835 for 2019, 2022 and 2024 alike (and the 2016 page quotes 'SV averages $20,021'), so the figure is evidently model-wide, not year-specific; recorded as printed but treat with caution.
Only the first 20 cards of each page were recorded (pages showed 29). No page was paginated.

TrueCar's stated 'average price for the <year> Rogue SV' figures ($20,273 / $20,098 / $20,188 / $20,098) are nearly identical across 2016-2024 and far above the 2016/2019 asking prices on the same pages; they appear to be a model-wide SV average, not year-specific. Recorded as printed in page_average; treat with caution.
Only the first 20 cards of each page were recorded (pages showed 29-30). No page was paginated.
2024 sample skews toward high-mileage ex-fleet units at non-Nissan dealers (three identical $15,400 cards from one Dublin, GA dealer); it may understate retail asking prices.
No year/trim 'averages $X' figure was present on any of the four Camry LE pages (TrueCar only quoted averages for other trims, e.g. SE), so page_average is null for all four years.
2024: three LE-filtered cards carried an extra 'SE' label in the card title; recorded as LE per the filter but flagged in note.
